welcome.genericHelper: I am here to help you with the subject.

studentMode.warning: Student mode: To configure the extension, import the configuration file provided by your teacher.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language affects the interface and agent responses

exerciseConfig.infoDesc: In this tab you can configure which exercises are student only or false friend.

infoList.challenge: Student only exercises: Explanations cannot be requested, but solution evaluations can.
infoList.picky: False friend exercises: The agent will intentionally give an incorrect answer so the student can practice critical review of AI-generated content.

exerciseConfig.infoFooter: After saving changes, the system will automatically update the restrictions.
exerciseConfig.noExercisesDesc: When exercises are detected on the page, you can configure which ones are student only exercises.
exerciseConfig.noLabOpenDesc: You must open a lab first to be able to add or configure exercises.
exerciseConfig.unsavedDesc: Click "Save changes" to apply the configuration and regenerate the agent.
exerciseConfig.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the exercise '{{name}}'?

labConfig.noLabsDesc: No 'page' type resources found in the subject that can be configured as labs.
labConfig.noLabsInSectionDesc: This section does not contain any 'page' type resources that can be configured as labs.
labConfig.infoDesc: Configure which labs to include and their verbosity and reasoning options.

infoList.include: Include lab: Enable this to analyze the lab and extract exercises. This is required before other configuration options can be used.
infoList.verbosity: Verbosity level: Controls the level of detail in the agent's explanations (low, medium, or high).
infoList.reasoning: Reasoning effort: Configures how much detail the agent should put into explaining its reasoning (minimal, low, medium, or high).

labConfig.infoFooter: Click on an included lab to expand its configuration options.
labConfig.unsavedDesc: Click "Save changes" to apply the configuration.
labConfig.unsavedContext: Context will be generated for newly included labs.
labConfig.deleteExerciseConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete exercise "{{name}}"?

labContext.title: Lab Context - {{name}}

learningObjectives.description: Define what students should learn from this lab.
learningObjectives.placeholder: Enter the learning objectives for this lab...

exercises.description: List of exercises identified in this lab. Exercises are configured from the exercise configuration tab.

concepts.description: List of concepts covered in this lab. You can add, edit, or remove concepts.

exerciseContext.description: Shared context for all exercises in this lab (e.g., database schema, specifications).

labContext.saveError: Error saving context. Please try again.

export.title: Export configuration
export.description: Export all your configuration (prompts, exercises, and labs) to a signed JSON file. You can use this file to make backups or transfer the configuration to another browser. The file is protected against manual modifications.

import.title: Import configuration
import.description: Import a configuration from a previously exported and signed JSON file. This will overwrite existing data with the file's data.
import.warningDesc: Importing will overwrite existing data. It is recommended to export first as a backup.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete all data stored by the extension. This action cannot be undone.
dangerZone.clearContextDescription: Delete only the generated context of labs (exercises and identified data). Agent prompts and other configurations will be preserved.

messages.importSignatureError: Invalid file signature. The file may have been modified manually.
messages.importFormatError: Invalid file format. Make sure you use a correctly exported file.
messages.importJsonError: The file does not contain valid JSON.
messages.invalidFile: Please select a valid JSON file.
messages.clearSuccess: All data has been deleted successfully
messages.clearContextSuccess: Lab context has been deleted successfully

importExport.confirmClear:
⚠️ WARNING: This action will delete ALL saved configuration, including:

- Agent configuration
- Identified exercise data
- Configured lab data

This action CANNOT be undone. Are you sure you want to continue?
importExport.confirmClearContext:
⚠️ WARNING: This action will delete ONLY the lab context (exercises and identified information):

- Identified exercise data
- Configured lab data

Agent prompts and other settings will be preserved.

This action CANNOT be undone. Are you sure you want to continue?

devMode.title: Developer options
devMode.description: This section is only visible in development mode (npm run dev).

forceTeacherRole.label: Force teacher role
forceTeacherRole.description: When enabled, the extension will always identify you as a teacher without checking eGela. Useful for development and testing.
forceTeacherRole.enabled: Enabled - Teacher role will be forced
forceTeacherRole.disabled: Disabled - Role will be verified in eGela
